{{Quote|There's a battle going on&mdash;right here in our system!|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="sw1">[[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Tatoo system''', also known as the '''Tatooine system''', and formerly known as the '''tri-planetary system J11.9''', contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] its twin suns, [[Tatoo I/Legends|Tatoo I]] and [[Tatoo II/Legends|Tatoo II]]. It was located in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].

==Description==
Tatoo system was a [[Binary star system/Legends|binary]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located at the crossroads of the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] and the [[Old Corellian Run]] in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] segment. The system formed around the [[Star/Legends#Types of stars|G-type]] [[Star/Legends|stars]] [[Tatoo I/Legends|Tatoo I]] and [[Tatoo II/Legends|Tatoo II]], and contained [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], its [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Ghomrassen/Legends|Ghomrassen]], [[Guermessa/Legends|Guermessa]] and [[Chenini/Legends|Chenini]], the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] [[Ohann]] and [[Adriana]], and their seven moons.<ref name="TEA" />

The twin suns of the Tatoo system caused premature aging in [[Human/Legends|Humans]] on Tatooine.<ref name="VG8">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp08.html|text=Episode IV Visual Guide — Chapter 8: Droids for Sale}}</ref>

==History==
===Early history===
[[File:Tatoo_system-TCW.png|thumb|left|250px|Tatooine, during the Clone Wars]]
Some early explorers thought the first planet of the system to be a third star, because of it blazing light reflected by its sodium-rich deserts.<ref name="EP4NOVEL">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref>

Tatooine had a strong presence in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], which led the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] to the Tatoo system.<ref name="DOTJFS1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref> The collapse of their empire in [[25,200 BBY]] caused the system to be left alone for some millennia.<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] explored the segment of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] wherein this system was located during the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]] and the [[Indecta Era]]. By [[1004 BBY]], the nearby region belonged to the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], including [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], a large region of the known galaxy controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species. After the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the system remained in Hutt control until the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|I doubt if the Empire would even fight to keep this system.|[[Laze Loneozner/Legends|Laze Loneozner]]|<ref name="EP4NOVEL" />}}
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] acquired the [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]], simply known as the Death Star. In the Tatoo system, the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|captured]] the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], which was carrying the plans to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] Organa placed the plans in an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] and ordered him to carry them to former [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] rode a [[Class-6 escape pod/Legends|Class-6 escape pod]] with the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to the planet Tatooine. After being captured by a clan of the native junk-trader [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], and bought by the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]], the droids met with Kenobi. Meanwhile, the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Desert Sands]] tracked the droids and killed the Jawas and the Larses. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], orphaned nephew of Lars, joined Kenobi in his quest to carry the plans to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. In [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], they hired [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], crew of the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. This ship breached the blockade of Tatooine and left for Alderaan with the plans.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a [[Unidentified Moradmin Bast look-alike|Moff]] put the Tatoo system under Imperial curfew. [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]], the bartender of Mos Eisley [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Cantina]] on Tatooine, received the message and reluctantly responded by [[Goodnight, But Not Goodbye/Legends|singing]] to her patrons to leave.

[[File:Moons_of_Tatooine.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Tatooine's three moons from space]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the system changed hands several times: its region was taken from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by the Empire during the [[Thrawn campaign]], but was left after the [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral's]] [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Legacy era===
Later the space around the Tatoo system was controlled by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], until the [[Sith–Imperial War]] [[127 ABY|127]]–[[130 ABY]], when the [[Fel Empire]] conquered much of the known galaxy, but was quickly replaced by [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tatoo system was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], ghostwritten by [[Alan Dean Foster]] and published in [[1976]].

Despite the twin suns appearing nearly identical in size in many sources, others show one star as being significantly larger than the other.

The game ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]'' shows an [[asteroid field]] right outside or near Tatooine, and ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' shows an asteroid field near Tatooine. This field appears in no other official sources.

The planet Kepler-16b has been informally referred to as Tatooine on numerous occasions.
